fifo.default_assertions: Run original and existing mutant at all three depths with upstream assertions enabled. Depth0 initial rejection is an unsupported configuration result, not a functional witness.
fifo.conditional: Additional Depth0 runs explicitly COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF. Presented stalls only legal under separately named passthrough contract; not under upstream full_write precondition.
fifo.oracle: Depth0 empty=!push, full=!pop, data=data_i; actual accepted=active && push && pop. For depths2/4 independent queue checks old-head data, empty/full/usage; no forbidden full writes/empty reads; clear/reset cancellation.
fifo.target: presented means push=1; count idle mismatch separately. Existing force-zero mutation algebraically cannot violate nonempty-on-present in two-state Depth0.
fifo.success: No historical success from artificial mutation or assertions-disabled unsupported parameter. Require distinct original-repair lineage and legal original witness.

stat_local.scope: Only isolated events under existing local prose; two PRE-NBA samples after event. Overlap deliberately diagnosed but remains specification/provenance unknown.
stat_local.status: Synthetic model only, never original historical stat repair.

stat_original.specification: Pinned README: count bytes and frames on monitored AXI stream; tlast end-of-frame. Pinned upstream test decodes >HLLL and expects frame/byte counts. Only complete frames before quiet trigger, trigger when not busy, contiguous low tkeep, stable monitor payload through stalls.
stat_original.checks: Independent accepted-beat byte count and accepted-tlast completed-frame count, tick snapshot, tag,14-byte output packet,tlast,output stability through backpressure. No fixed frame_done-to-output latency claim.
stat_original.limitation: Original source only, no repaired revision. Any confirmed discrepancy is a new bounded original-source observation, NOT restored case505 provenance or successful historical repair.

unknown_policy: Missing source mapping, unsupported config, absent exposure or no fixed revision cannot count as historical success. No inferred permission from lack of a ready port.
